en: Sepia-toned street scene in a historic European city. A gently curving street is lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops with awnings and signage. Pedestrians crowd the sidewalks and a tram or streetcar runs on tracks in the street. At the end of the street stands a church-like tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock faces. The overall style is late 19th to early 20th century central-European architecture.
